**Before any clip:** 19 outfit cards (one per person per story day where the outfit isn't the cast sheet's, plus a face-and-hair crop, HT26), the product and info cards (PRODUCT = the photo set; INFO-WORN-WENDY, INFO-SEAT), and the §24I voice masters (one per speaking character, 9). These are made scene by scene, as each scene starts.
**Seedance spend (estimate):** 506s of takes × ~63 Kie cr/s ≈ **31,878 Kie credits** for one pass (Kie balance 99,229.6). Plus the voice masters (9 × ~10 s ≈ 5,700) and the outfit and info cards (Sunburst, 2.75 Higgsfield cr each).
